scope: Synthetic local two-cell cluster with pumps, Kv1p5 channels and physical-time junction gates in a closed three-region extracellular mesh; CPU/L4 numerical composition, no biological fit or native BETSE spatial parity
electrical_scope: Every cell faces one local extracellular owner; all junctions remain within that capacitor component. Cross-region junctions require a different coupled field closure and are rejected.
normalized_field_residual: Each backend independently requires the normalized current residual <= 1. This roundoff diagnostic is bounded on both backends, not treated as a physical observable requiring identical floating-point cancellation noise.
